notes.title: Game will become free!
notes.content:
Good day! More than three years have passed since the game was released, and we, as a whole team, decided that our early work should be seen by a large number of people. Thank you for your paid purchases, you supported us very much, thanks to you we know that everything was not in vain!

Wait for 15.01.2024

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello again! Voice acting from AniLibria is now in the game!

A short while after the release, we're ready to present you the Russian voice-over for the game, which you will be able to listen to simultaneously while reading to enhance your experience.

We're also happy to announce that this update coincided with the Steam fall sale, so right now you can buy our game with a 15% discount.

We also added a small DLC, it's very short, but this does not make it less atmospheric, be sure to pay attention to it.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273570

[url=https://vk.com/teromioset][img]https://i.imgur.com/eGroEor.jpeg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Our visual novel, "Four Rendezvous" is finally out!
notes.content:
Our visual novel, "Four Rendezvous" is finally out!
For the first week after the release, you can get the game with a hefty discount, be sure to pick it up if you were interested in our work for a while.
Enjoy a plot full of twists and turns, well-done art and beautiful music. Read carefully and make wise decisions — the game has four endings and not all of them are good.
We're eagerly waiting for your feedback...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rQUxv2q.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273570/Four_Rendezvous/
